verdict.rationale: Xero describes AI features that work in the background without prompting: JAX categorizes and matches bank transactions "while you're busy with your real work," forwarded bills are auto-extracted into drafts, and duplicate bills are flagged automatically. Custom Connections (M2M) and the SDKs let developers build their own unattended integrations. However, the evidence shows no user-facing way to define, schedule or trigger custom automations, bill automation still stops at drafts awaiting approval, and all claims are vendor marketing. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation/workflow builder with triggers or schedules, documented scope and controls for autonomous background runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
